tooltip.active: Agent Ready — on · click to restore · right-click for settings
tooltip.activeDigest: Agent Ready — on · %1 agent runtimes · click to restore

hero.title: Agent Ready

toggle.notifyDesc: Off by default — the bar card and Bark are the primary prompts.
toggle.enterNowDesc: Skip the remaining countdown from the arming card.
toggle.autoDesc: Enter automatically after a period of no local input.
toggle.disarmOnInputDesc: If you touch the keyboard or mouse while an auto countdown runs, abort it.
auto.status: Threshold: %1s of idle (follows the system by default).
auto.unavailable: System idle time is too short; auto-arm disabled.
toggle.inhibitDesc: Including lid close. Laptop will not sleep.
toggle.idleDesc: Drives Omarchy's own Stay Awake switch.
toggle.powerDesc: Uses powerprofilesctl; restores the previous profile on exit.
toggle.dpmsDesc: Turns outputs off; activity lights them again.
toggle.muteDesc: Off by default: the hardware mute control can pop on this machine.
toggle.freezeDesc: Experimental: SIGSTOP matching processes; agents are allow-listed out.
hint.nextEnter: Changes apply the next time Agent Ready turns on.
arming.hint: Click the bar icon or Cancel to abort; 'Enter now' skips the wait.
arming.hintAuto: Auto-armed after idle. Any keyboard/mouse input cancels it.
digest.title: Watch digest
digest.agents: %1 agent runtime kinds detected during the watch
lang.hint: Only this plugin's panel and notifications change; the rest of the system keeps its own language.
toggle.digestDesc: Record every watch and open the summary on unlock. Turn off to stop recording.
digest.subtitle: Every watch, from the beginning
digest.disabled: Digest recording is off — enable it in Advanced.
notify.armingBody: Will: %1. Click Cancel or the bar icon to abort.
notify.enter: Agents stay online; display, audio and idle are dimmed. Click the bar icon to restore.
notify.leave: Restored display, audio and power profile. System can suspend again.
notify.barkAuto: Idle threshold reached — entering Agent Ready
status.arming: Agent Ready — entering in %1s · click to cancel · right-click for settings
status.off: Agent Ready — OFF · click to keep agents online while dimming the desktop
status.inhibitorLost: ⚠ Agent Ready inhibitor lost — run 'omarchy-agent-ready on' to repair.
